data.has_dobbe: I have a Dobbe module (experimental live stream)

data_description.power_entity: Optional. Pick a sensor with the whole house's power, e.g. Tibber Pulse/Watty. Used for live power and a forecast of this hour's average. A charger such as Easee only shows the charger's power and does not fit.
data_description.has_dobbe: Pick this if you have a Dobbe module (the HAN sensor that sends your meter readings to Amperium). The integration then connects to Amperium's live feed, the one the app uses, and you get "Power now (Amperium live, experimental)". The first time, the aio-pika library is installed. "Power now" uses it when you have no power sensor of your own, or yours is unavailable. It has not been confirmed that the module delivers live readings; see the attributes of "Power now (Amperium live, experimental)".

error.invalid_day_hours: Day must start before it ends.

login_expiring.title: Amperium login expires soon
login_expiring.description: Your Amperium login expires in about {days} days. Log in again with a one-time code before then: open the reconfigure/re-login prompt on the integration under Settings → Devices & services → Amperium.

hent_periode.name: Get period
hent_periode.description: Cost and consumption for a free period: electricity (including the fixed monthly price), grid rent before and after subsidy, Norgespris compensation and the average price per kWh. Dates count in local time, and the end date is NOT included (2026-09-01 to 2026-10-01 is all of September). The answer is returned as response data. Amperium does not say how the fixed monthly price and the capacity charge are shared in a period that is not a whole month; the answer lists them separately and warns when the period spans a month end. The fixed monthly price is part of the electricity amount, not an extra.

fra.name: From
fra.description: First day of the period, included (00:00 local time). A date and time is taken exactly.

til.name: To
til.description: The day the period ends: this day is NOT included (00:00 local time). A date and time is taken exactly.

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: Which Amperium entry to use. Only needed with more than one.

koble_til_live.name: Reconnect live feed
koble_til_live.description: Drops Amperium's live stream and subscribes again at once, with the waiting between attempts reset. Use it when "Power now (Amperium live, experimental)" is unavailable and you do not want to restart Home Assistant. Only has an effect when the option "I have a Dobbe module (experimental live stream)" is on.

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: Which Amperium entry to use. Only needed with more than one.

oppdater_navn.name: Update entity IDs to the invoice names
oppdater_navn.description: From 0.14.0 the sensors are named after the invoice, but an entity ID that already exists does not change by itself. This action gives the renamed sensors the ID Home Assistant would give them on a new installation. By default (show only) it changes nothing and only shows what it would do. Everything that mentions the old IDs (templates, automations, dashboards, the Energy panel) must be updated at the same time. Sensors you have named yourself are left alone.

kun_vis.name: Show the plan only
kun_vis.description: On (default): nothing is changed, the answer only shows what would change. Off: the IDs are changed.
